message.content:
Wool-blend coat with a straight cut and knee-length hem in deep charcoal #2F4F4F, dense water-resistant fabric.
Thermal turtleneck sweater with a relaxed fit and elbow-length sleeves in navy blue #000080, soft fine-knit merino wool.
Tailored wool trousers with a classic straight leg and ankle length in dark grey #36454F, heavy flannel material.
Leather ankle boots with a low block heel and mid-calf height in black #000000, waterproof oiled leather with salt-resistant lining.
Silver-tone scarf wrap necklace and wool felt ear muffs for warmth.
This outfit works because the straight-cut coat and tailored trousers provide necessary insulation against the -15 °C temperature while allowing comfortable movement during a snowy walk to work. The dark, neutral color palette creates a professional silhouette suitable for an office environment even when covered in light salt spray or falling snow. Additional layers like the thermal turtleneck and wool accessories ensure her core stays warm without bulk, respecting her need for practicality on foot.
